QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_4

question.text: Ms. Priya Shah, a first-time LP, asks the IM of Kaveri Opportunities Fund to explain how management fees differ from incentive fees. The CORRECT framing is:

answer.text: Management fees are fixed and independent of performance; incentive fees are paid only on incremental return above thresholds
Both are paid only if the fund beats its hurdle
Management fees are paid only on profits; incentive fees are paid irrespective of performance
Management fees include GST but incentive fees are GST-exempt

explanation.text: The Logic: Management fees are fixed and paid irrespective of gains or losses for management services. Incentive fees are charged on incremental return / profits above thresholds such as the hurdle rate and the High Water Mark. The Trap: Option C reverses the two definitions. Option B is false because management fees have no performance gate. Option D is not supported by the workbook. Note: The fixed-versus-performance fee distinction is set out in the fee chapter of the workbook.
